card.name: Partway through Lao script and odd words
card.fires_on: Broken pieces of Lao or Gurmukhi script characters inside a word, and occasionally the middle of rare Latin-script words such as Fentanyl, Anthophora or Tryptophan.

modes.label: Lao script bytes
modes.description: Partial bytes inside Lao or Punjabi script letters in a quoted motto or name.

modes.label: Inside rare Latin words
modes.description: Middle pieces of long drug or species names, such as oph or entanyl.

card.plain: It fires on broken pieces of foreign-script letters and the middle of unusual long words, with no clear medical meaning.
